checks.scope: References to numbered phases from other surfaces.
checks.observable: Inserting a phase demonstrates ordinal instability.
checks.consistency: A recommended cross-technique phase link conflicts with AP-157.
checks.exceptions: Local references and orientation links need separate treatment.
checks.fix: Name a supplied outcome/precondition; keep cross-technique sequencing at binds.
checks.expression: The heading-link repair silently assumes access to the target text.

entries.rationale: Stable naming alone does not provide the referenced instruction or value.

checks.scope: Repeated shared capability, not necessarily repeated raw tool use.
checks.observable: Duplicate interpretation/policy is evidence of shared work; two call sites alone are insufficient.
checks.consistency: Required extraction can produce the wrapper AP-158 retires.
checks.exceptions: Add primitive-use exemption when caller readings differ.
checks.fix: Extract the shared reading only when one exists.
checks.expression: Capability needs a semantic contribution beyond the same tool name.

entries.rationale: A call-and-return wrapper is not justified by occurrence count alone.

checks.scope: Local output liveness over a declared consumer boundary.
checks.observable: Trace actual binds/remaps to readers; name matches alone are weak evidence.
checks.consistency: Reconcile actual consumers with AP-109 potentially bindable products.
checks.exceptions: External library consumers are appropriately recognized but evidence limits should be explicit.
checks.fix: Remove proved dead outputs, not merely unsearched public contracts.
checks.expression: Can bind the op is weaker than does consume this output.

entries.rationale: A consumer inventory and dataflow check would make no-reader claims reproducible.

checks.scope: Operative framing absent from section delivery.
checks.observable: The delivered span and required obligations can be compared directly.
checks.consistency: DP-44 requires framing reach; a character-count heuristic does not establish it.
checks.exceptions: Orientation-only prose is correctly exempt regardless of length.
checks.fix: Update dependent citations as well as introducing the addressable section.
checks.expression: Roughly 100 characters is a poor proxy for operative importance.

entries.rationale: A short rule can be decisive; an unrequested new section remains undelivered.

checks.observable: Protocol/Rules text search misses templates and Output recognition criteria.
checks.consistency: Output-owned recognition is allowed by AP-111; Apply repairs conflict with AP-114.
checks.exceptions: Container reach is valid; applied-op exemption preserves a prohibited path.
checks.fix: Wire the real consumer or delete a proved unused slot.
checks.expression: Never read is a semantic claim stronger than absent in two sections.

entries.rationale: The current detector can flag a live input and reward a redundant mention.

checks.scope: The subject is a Protocol Apply form AP-114 removes.
checks.observable: Required-input comparison is inspectable but belongs at supported bind sites.
checks.consistency: Adding arguments preserves the separately prohibited invocation.
checks.exceptions: Activity binds are excluded even though they are the canonical invocation surface.
checks.fix: Retire the Protocol-Apply repair or restate binding completeness at actual binds.
checks.expression: The detailed contract resolution is useful at the correct layer.

entries.rationale: Move the valuable completeness test to a form the canon endorses.

checks.scope: Magnitude-based branches lacking an available comparison value.
checks.observable: A declared threshold, policy row, or returned budget supplies evidence.
checks.consistency: Observable qualitative conditions are expressly allowed.
checks.exceptions: Harness-owned thresholds and counts derivable from existing definitions are protected.
checks.fix: Declare a real owner or use an observable condition.
checks.expression: The example list illustrates missing operands without requiring all principles to be numeric.

entries.rationale: This is a useful model of an observable criterion with qualitative carve-outs.

checks.scope: Already-delivered inherited or bundled rule rosters.
checks.observable: Compare actual delivery with the repeating citation list.
checks.consistency: Container ownership is valid but does not excuse a container copying another roster.
checks.fix: Delete redundant rosters while retaining unique qualifications.
checks.expression: Already receives is a meaningful prerequisite that must be proved.

entries.rationale: A small exception clarification handles duplicate container rosters.
